purpose: Define the next standalone-student route after dense-only v58 failed: preserve BGE-M3's dense+sparse+multi-vector retrieval surface instead of training another plain dense SentenceTransformer checkpoint.

best_completed_retrieval_system.method: BGE-M3 hybrid r100 + BGE-reranker-v2-m3 min-max score blend
best_completed_retrieval_system.claim_scope: retrieval system, not standalone embedding model

head_student_v59.decision: reject exact raw-listwise head-only recipe for scaling

research_basis.implication: The model's published strength is the joint dense, sparse, and multi-vector retrieval surface trained with self-knowledge distillation.
Official finetuning supports teacher-score knowledge distillation when pos_scores and neg_scores are present.
The M3 trainer exposes unified_finetuning, kd_loss_type, use_self_distill, and separate sparse/ColBERT training behavior.
Official installation distinguishes inference-only and finetune extras; a stable finetune environment may require a clean finetune install or CUDA-devel container.
MarginMSELoss is valid for teacher-score distillation generally, but the v51/v58 results show it is the wrong standalone dense objective for this hybrid teacher.

v59_design.name: hybrid-aware BGE-M3 student distillation v2
not_allowed: Do not train another dense-only SentenceTransformer BGE-M3 checkpoint from the same teacher rows.
Do not scale v51, v52, v53, v54, or v58 checkpoints.
Do not promote Gemma to primary teacher unless a held-out blend or ensemble beats v56.
preferred_path: Use the existing v58 train/held-out split but preserve raw teacher score distributions rather than saturated tanh margins.
Train only the BGE-M3 sparse_linear and colbert_linear heads first; keep the encoder and dense representation anchored.
Replace pointwise margin MSE with a listwise KL or cross-entropy target over each query's positive plus hard negatives.
Normalize teacher scores per query, preserving ranking shape instead of forcing all target margins near 1.0.
Add an anchor term against base BGE-M3 hybrid scores so the student cannot destroy the strong frozen base ordering.
Evaluate every candidate through the existing hybrid evaluator path, not dense-only SentenceTransformer encode.
fallback_path: If custom head-only remains unstable, create a clean FlagEmbedding[finetune] CUDA-devel environment and retry official m3 teacher-score training with torchrun.
If training remains negative, shift from model distillation to a publishable system/leaderboard package while collecting broader ArabicMTEB evidence.

validation_gate.stage_0: No GPU training until the v59 objective and evaluator are implemented and unit-tested on synthetic rows. Objective plumbing and the same-candidate diagnostic gate are now implemented locally.
validation_gate.stage_1: Run a 128-row smoke on the same candidate-pool diagnostic used by v52-v54. Required improvement: at least +0.005 nDCG@10 over base, not a v53-style +0.00035 noise gain.
validation_gate.stage_2: Run the fixed 200-query / 5000-document MIRACL Arabic sample used by v58. Required: no regression versus frozen BGE-M3 and preferably a measurable gain.
validation_gate.stage_3: Only after stages 1-2 pass, evaluate full MIRACL Arabic dev with the hybrid scorer and compare against BGE-M3 hybrid r100 0.801110 and v56 system 0.828605.

next_engineering_steps: Do not scale the exact v59 remote GPU smoke; it only produced a noise-level +0.000051 nDCG@10 gain.
Before the next GPU training attempt, redesign the target construction or trainer surface so the expected gain is meaningfully larger than the +0.005 gate.
